author: Richard Nakamoto
name: ClipTV
description: Soundboard for audio and video clips: big colour-coded buttons, playlists, random play, infinite loops.
long_description: ClipTV turns your device into a soundboard: assign audio (.wav) and video (.mjpeg or .rgb565) clips to colorful buttons and play them with a single tap. Four sounds are bundled (a 1990s phone ring, a dog, a pig and a cat); add your own from a microSD card. Buttons can play a fixed clip, an ordered or shuffled playlist, or a random one (audio, video, or anything), optionally looping forever, with an equaliser animation while a sound plays and on-screen volume controls. Configure the number of buttons per screen, add extra screens with one tap, and rename and color-code every button. Runs on the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.5 (onboard ES8311 speaker) and the ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-2 (with a PCM5102A I2S DAC). Free software under the GNU GPL v3 or later.
